description: memcue: recall facts before each prompt, extract facts at compaction and session end

hooks.command: command -v memcue >/dev/null 2>&1 && { if memcue version -minimum 0.4.0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then memcue session-start; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"memcue: the binary is older than 0.4.0; update memcue to get the session card and the facts again after a compaction."}}'; fi; } || true
